prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which player who scored more than 10 goals in the 2022 Argentine Premier League season also played for Elche in Spain?
answer: None. The 2022 Argentine top-flight players who scored more than 10 goals were Mateo Retegui (19), Franco Cristaldo (14), and Enzo Copetti (11); none of them played for Elche in Spain as of August 1, 2024.
